<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json aca58cdb62bdb8ed350f0b45885728374ca1f6ad` → `packageMentionDocs`.

- 为什么改:#29318(PR #29239 落地后的复审 should-fix):旧句子和 ADR-0132 矛盾。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e82aa69ae79e185d3a6aabc93d00c4930824bda7`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts + docs/adr/0132-multi-organization-runtime-is-open-core.md (D1–D4), docs/adr/0105-group-tenancy-posture-and-first-class-org-scope.md (D12 and its 2026-07-27 and 2026-09-06 amendments), docs/adr/0093-tenancy-mode-and-membership-lifecycle.md (D5), packages/plugins/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/organizations/src/membership-policy-gate.ts, packages/plugins/organizations/package.json, .changeset/29318-tenancy-posture-activation-prose.md

Inputs: card #29318 (body, triage 6576560344, claim 6580442396, dev report 6581334071), PR #29454 body and file list, `git diff origin/main...e82aa69a` (merge-base `a6441636`), the head's check-runs. The seat's ACCEPT (6581394170) was read as a record of what it claims, not as evidence; every claim below was re-derived from the tree and the cited ADRs.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: unchanged.** Both hunks in `tenancy-posture.ts` lie inside `/** … */` blocks (the file header, lines 23–48, and the `postureStampsOrganization` docblock). The file contains zero `.describe()` calls on `main` and at the head; `TenancyPostureSchema`, `OrgScopingEntitlementSchema`, `PlatformGlobalObjectsSchema`, every exported function and `OrgScopingEntitlement` are byte-identical. `packages/spec/api-surface/security.json` records existence only (five entries from this file, none moved) and `content/docs/references/security/misc.mdx` carries no sentence from either docblock. Comment-only holds.
- **Done-when, sentence by sentence.** Header: "On an OPEN install, activation is gate-free … mounting it is enough" names the open side; "On a COMMERCIAL host, activation is entitled … There, and only there, open code does not mean free activation" names the commercial side. Docblock: "On an open install mounting it is enough (ADR-0132 D4); only on a commercial host is that activation licence-gated (ADR-0132 D2)". No sentence in the file now says, or can be read to say, that an open install is licence-gated. The sibling `OrgScopingEntitlement` docblock (unchanged) already scopes "the commercial runtime owns it" and "on a commercial host that is the licence-gated one" to that side and names D4 for the open package, so it does not reintroduce the defect.
- **ADR-0016 paragraph vs. the paragraph above it.** The old text grounded the iron rule in "not by giving the posture away", which, read beside "That runtime is open code too", asserted a withheld posture that the open package no longer withholds. The new text grounds it in the wall ("REFUSING to run one unwalled, ADR-0093 D5") on both sides and hands the "is switching it on free" question to the entitlement bullets. That is exactly the distinction ADR-0105 D12's 2026-07-27 amendment draws ("a security property (never run a multi-org shape unwalled), not a packaging one (give the posture away)") and ADR-0132's Context section repeats ("a wall is enforcement"). The two paragraphs no longer contradict each other. The Chinese quotation 强制免费、治理收费 is unchanged.
- **Factual claims, each against its source.**
  - "ENABLING a multi-organization posture … requires the `@objectstack/organizations` runtime to be mounted (ADR-0105 D12, ADR-0093 D5)" — D12: both walled postures probe the `org-scoping` runtime, without it the posture resolves `single` + `degraded` and `serve` refuses; D5: the refusal. True.
  - "ships from this repository under Apache-2.0 (ADR-0132 D1)" — D1 verbatim; `packages/plugins/organizations/package.json` `"license": "Apache-2.0"`. True.
  - "The open runtime carries no licence check of any kind (ADR-0132 D2)" — D2's own words; the plugin constructor (organizations-plugin.ts ≈L243–258) has no gate call, option, hook or callback and says so. True.
  - "entitles both walled postures by construction (ADR-0132 D4)" — D4; `supportedPostures = ['group', 'isolated']` at ≈L236. True.
  - "The commercial package of the same name subclasses the open one and answers its licence gate in its own constructor, and the host's manifest resolves the name to that package (ADR-0132 D2, D3); it may also narrow which walled postures it entitles" — D2 (subclassing, gate in constructor), D3 (`workspace:*` resolution from the host manifest), D4 closing sentence and the ADR-0105 amendment ("the commercial runtime may still narrow what it entitles"). The closed code is not readable from this repo; the prose cites the ADRs and not the code, which is the right footing. True as far as the open record reaches.
  - "There, and only there, open code does not mean free activation" — the ADR-0105 2026-09-06 amendment's "still an entitlement on the commercial side". True.
  - "the platform delivers by REFUSING to run one unwalled (ADR-0093 D5) … You never silently get an unenforced organization boundary" — D5 refuses by default; its `OS_ALLOW_DEGRADED_TENANCY=1` escape is loud (terminal warning plus `/auth/config`), so "silently" is the right qualifier. Pre-existing wording, mirrored in ADR-0105 D12 itself. True.
- **Overstatement check.** One phrase is loose rather than false: "activation is gate-free … mounting it is enough" (header bullet). On an open install a walled posture still meets the membership-policy boot refusal (`assertWalledMembershipPolicyDeclared`, membership-policy-gate.ts, run from the open plugin's `init`), which the plugin itself calls a "gate". It is a safety check, not an entitlement, and the bullet's next clause defines "gate" as the licence check, so the sentence is not a false statement of fact. Should-fix (nice-to-have): "licence-gate-free" / "mounting it is all the entitlement there is" would close the reading. Not blocking.
- **Noted, not filed (outside the card's file surface):** `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts:202` (a test `note`) still ends "not by giving the posture away". It already states D2 and D4 in the same sentence, so it is not contradictory, only stale in emphasis.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/spec` **patch** is right. Comment-only on a published package: no key, accepted value, default, meaning, export or type moves, so `Metadata-protocol: none` and `Clause-②: no` (no arm) are the only correct declarations, and `none` takes `patch`. Both lines appear on the PR body and in the changeset body, identically. The `postureStampsOrganization` JSDoc ships in the published `.d.ts`, so a changeset (not `skip-changeset`) is the right carrier.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Not a governed surface: paths are `packages/spec/src/**` and `.changeset/**`; the Governed Surface Queue Guard check-run is `success`. The review is owed by the published-schema face (`hits`: `packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts`), which is why this record exists.
- Head repo = base repo (`objectstack-ai/objectstack`), branch `claude/project-thread-n75m44`; not a fork PR.
- Open/commercial line: the prose draws it where ADR-0132 draws it and no further; nothing here restates or decides the commercial half (ADR-0132 Provenance), and no new citation of a cloud record is introduced.
- Check-runs on `e82aa69a` as polled at 2026-11-02T15:46Z: 18 `success` (among them Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Lint · ESLint, Type Check · source gates, PR-body guards, Check PR Size), 12 `skipped`, 16 `in_progress` (Test Core 1–8, Build Core, Build UI Deps, Live E2E UI, Type Check · consumer gates / workspace / debt ledger, Lint · docs & code guards), 0 `failure`. Green is not yet established; landing waits for the required set.

### ④ Design judgment

Judged against ADR-0132 D1–D4, the ADR-0105 D12 amendments and the open plugin on `main`. The header now carries the implementation/entitlement split as two side-scoped bullets instead of one unqualified sentence, and it keeps the three load-bearing facts a reader of the spec needs: the wall is open, mounting the open runtime is the whole activation story on an open install, and the commercial subclass is where entitlement lives. The ADR-0016 paragraph is rebuilt on the same ground the ADRs stand on (refusal, not withholding), so the file no longer argues with itself. The docblock on `postureStampsOrganization` repeats the scoping in one sentence rather than restating the header. Nothing is promised that the code does not enforce, apart from the "gate-free" looseness above, which is a should-fix and not a must-fix. No must-fix found.

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；

> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）
